Container.Name: arr-digest
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted digest bot for Sonarr and Radarr. Listens for their webhook notifications, shows additions/upgrades/removals live in a web UI, and posts summaries to Discord, on a schedule or instantly, to one or more channels. Upgrades are reported as upgrades, never as a removal plus an addition.
After starting the container, open the WebUI and create your login straight away, then follow the Settings page to connect Sonarr/Radarr and add Discord destinations. Forgot the password? Run: docker exec arr-digest node server/dist/cli/reset-auth.js

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI, and for the webhook URLs you'll paste into Sonarr/Radarr

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database (settings, event history)

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone. Note: the digest send time itself is set in the app's Settings page, in whatever timezone you pick there — this only affects container logs/timestamps.
